en: Hebrews 11

p.src: 1  Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

en: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
u.src: 1  Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

p.src: 2  For by this, the elders obtained approval.

ja: によって神に認められました。
en: For by this, the elders obtained approval.
u.src: 2  For by this, the elders obtained approval.

p.src: 3  By faith we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.

ja: られたことを理解します。したがって、
られたのではありません。
en: By faith we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.
u.src: 3  By faith we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.

p.src: 4  By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.

ja: によって、アベルはカインより
にささげました。これによって
についてあかしされました。また、
んだ今もなお、これによって
en: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.
u.src: 4  By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.

p.src: 5  By faith Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.

ja: され、見つからなくなりました。
ばれていたとあかしされていました。
en: By faith Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.
u.src: 5  By faith Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.

p.src: 6  Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

ja: ばれることはできません。
じなければならないからです。
en: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.
u.src: 6  Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

p.src: 7  By faith Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.

ja: け、神への畏れを抱き、 自分の
うために箱舟を造りました。その
en: By faith Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.
u.src: 7  By faith Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.

en: 11:7 or, reverence

p.src: 8  By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.

ja: によって、アブラハムは
en: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.
u.src: 8  By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.

p.src: 9  By faith he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.

ja: ぐイサク、ヤコブとともに、
en: By faith he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.
u.src: 9  By faith he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.

p.src: 10  For he was looking for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

ja: 設された、確かな基のある
en: For he was looking for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
u.src: 10  For he was looking for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

p.src: 11  By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.

en: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.
u.src: 11  By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.

p.src: 12  Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.

en: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.
u.src: 12  Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.

p.src: 13  These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

ja: にました。ただ、それをはるか
であると告白しました。
en: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
u.src: 13  These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

ja: 11:13 TRは「確信し」を加えている。
en: 11:13 TR adds “and being convinced of”

p.src: 14  For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.

en: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.
u.src: 14  For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.

p.src: 15  If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.

ja: は十分にあったでしょう。
en: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.
u.src: 15  If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.

p.src: 16  But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

ja: しかし実際には、もっと優れた
を用意されたからです。
en: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.
u.src: 16  But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

p.src: 17  By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his only born son,

を ささげようとしたのです。
en: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his only born son,
u.src: 17  By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his only born son,

ja: 11:17 「ひとり子」という句はギリシャ語の「μονογενη」に由来し、「独り子」または「ただ一人の子」と訳されることもある。
en: 11:17 The phrase “only born” is from the Greek word “μονογενη”, which is sometimes translated “only begotten” or “one and only”.

p.src: 18  to whom it was said, “Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac,”

en: to whom it was said, “Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac,”
u.src: 18  to whom it was said, “Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac,”

en: 11:18 Genesis 21:12

p.src: 19  concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.

ja: からでもイサクをよみがえらせることができると
えました。そして、比喩的に
en: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.
u.src: 19  concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.

p.src: 20  By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.

en: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.
u.src: 20  By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.

p.src: 21  By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.

en: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.
u.src: 21  By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.

らの出エジプトについて語り、
en: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel, and gave instructions concerning his bones.
u.src: 22  By faith Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel, and gave instructions concerning his bones.

ja: されました。両親はその子が美しいのを見て、
en: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.
u.src: 23  By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.

en: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,

u.src: 25  choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time,

u.src: 26  considering the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.

en: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.
u.src: 28  By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.

en: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.
u.src: 29  By faith they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.
